newsitem.title: USA: Pittston Brink's buys Venezuela unit.
newsitem.headline: Pittston Brink's buys Venezuela unit.

text.p: Pittston Brink's Group said Thursday its Brink's unit was the successful bidder to acquire nearly all of the remaining shares in its Venezuelan armoured car affiliate that it does not already own for $58 million.
Brink's currently owns 15 percent of Custodia Y Traslado de Valores CA (Custravalca), the largest armoured car company in Venezuela, Pittston said.
The deal is scheduled to close in January.
Pittston Brink said it expects the transaction to boost earnings beginning in 1997, the company said.
Pittston Brink's said the deal will be financed with borrowings in the Venezuelan markets and, possibly, local investors in a minority interest in Custravalca.
Custravalca also owns a 31 percent stake in Brink's Peru S.A., the largest armoured car company in Peru, Pittston said. Custravalca has annual revenues of about $70 million.
Pittston Brink's stock edged down 12.5 cents to $26 on the New York Stock Exchange shortly before midday.
